samples.tipping_evidence: Reachable clipboard wallet substitution, remote shell/payload commands, screenshot export and DDoS tasking exceed a consensual administration client. Main starts the clipper and hides persistence/security-exclusion launches.
execution_paths: Settings .cctor RVA 0x21e4 -> Main RVA 0x2280 -> AlgorithmAES.Decrypt RVA 0x4ff0: Base64/AES ECB; MD5 of the embedded seed copied into key offsets 0 and 15. Configuration decrypts to XWorm V5.6, 94.72.98.32:7000, %Temp%/Updated.exe, and replacement BTC/ETH addresses. Endpoint was not accessed.

Main RVA 0x2280 copies Helper.current with ReadAllBytes/WriteAllBytes, creates minute schtasks, writes HKCU CurrentVersion/Run and saves a Startup shortcut. Highest task privileges are requested only after an administrator test, not an elevation bypass.
Main.Exclusion RVA 0x26d8 invokes hidden PowerShell Add-MpPreference for paths and processes. Main starts Clipper.Run through its first thread delegate.

ClientSocket.ConnectServer RVA 0x2954 starts asynchronous receive; BeginRead RVA 0x326c -> Messages.Read RVA 0x35c0 decrypts and splits task bytes. RunShell sends task argument 1 to Interaction.Shell; LN downloads a task URL to a temporary file and starts the same path.

plugin/savePlugin handlers retrieve or save compressed bytes in HKCU and call Messages.Plugin RVA 0x3e54 -> AppDomain.Load -> inspect and invoke plugin methods. FM -> Memory RVA 0x4788 loads bytes and invokes the entry point.

$Cap path in Messages.Read uses CopyFromScreen, JPEG encoding, compression and Base64 before ClientSocket.Send. Info -> Antivirus RVA 0x2d48 queries SecurityCenter2/AntivirusProduct and returns that inventory in its sent host report.

StartDDos -> Messages.TD RVA 0x43b8 fans out 20 threads per loop. Lambda RVA 0x4824 connects to the supplied destination and sends Content-length: 5235 without a body, sleeps 2500 ms and disposes the socket.

NotificationForm.WndProc RVA 0x4d94 handles WM_CLIPBOARDUPDATE (797), reads clipboard text, tests wallet regexes, substitutes Settings.BTC/ETH, writes via ClipboardFunc.SetText and sends the original/replacement report. The configured TRC value is a placeholder; working TRC20 redirection is not claimed.
samples.coverage: All original hostile and suspicious findings preserved. Added linked wallet replacement and backdoor Run-key reference coverage; the latter describes co-occurrence, not a matcher-proven registry value flow.
limits: Delivery, operator authorization and live C2 status are unknown. Success is not claimed. OfflineKeylogger explicitly reports not enabled; plugin operation names do not prove that a missing plugin is present.

samples.identification: yyzUSB resource-wrapper file infector and USB spreader
samples.tipping_evidence: It replaces discovered executable files with copies of itself while preserving their original bodies as RCDATA. Removable-drive self-copy and hidden autorun generation establish propagation beyond honest USB monitoring.
execution_paths: 0x46b1a0 enumerates *.exe and calls 0x46d550. That routine gets its own module path, copies itself to a temporary file, reads the victim, stores victim bytes as RCDATA/99 with Begin/Update/EndUpdateResourceW, copies the wrapper over the victim, then deletes the temporary copy.

Startup host restoration 0x46d970 extracts RCDATA/99 to host.exe, creates a process for the preserved original, waits, and deletes staging files. This preserves the apparent function of infected applications.
0x475410 loops drive letters and checks removable/USB media -> 0x475840 self-copy. 0x454220 builds Autorun.inf, and copied executable/autorun attributes are set to hidden/system (6).
0x464f30 resolves URLDownloadToFileW through Urlmon and passes the staged output to ShellExecuteW. Existing downloader findings are supported, not evidence for a specific current C2.

0x471270 opens Device/PhysicalMemory, grants access through its DACL when denied, then kernel-export/SSDT lookup and patch/restore paths at 0x472138 and 0x471a60 coexist with security-product targeting. No success on current Windows is claimed.

samples.identification: Native carrier with an XOR-encoded remote-control DLL
samples.tipping_evidence: A staged FreeEIM-claimed executable reconstructs a covert RAT DLL, loads it and invokes its exports. The recovered DLL handles received command bytes, runs supplied command data and maintains disguised autorun copying; this contradicts the messenger/runtime broker presentation.
execution_paths: Outer E-language user routine 0x4010cb passes R.exe/N.exe paths and embedded byte-array values into its file-write and launch runtime services. The array headers supply exact lengths rather than PE virtual image extents.

R.exe is array bytes [0x81a3b, +964096], sha256 bc29f2022ab3b812e50c8681ff196f090c038b5ab51e37daffac4469a8c2eb2c. N.exe is [0x16d04b, +386560], sha256 3de6c02f52a661b8f934f59541d0cf297bb489eb2155e346b63c7338e09aeaf8; its packed implementation was not fully recovered or assigned a family.

R.exe entry -> 0x401af0 -> 0x401370 -> 0x4012d0 XORs the first third of 0xe0c00 bytes at VA 0x403020 with the low bytes of twelve stack words: f7 08 06 07 a9 01 06 09 07 a0 08 07. 0x401000 writes the decoded buffer to the chosen path. 0x401af0 loads that same temporary .txt path and resolves/calls Install or MainThread; the Install branch can relaunch via rundll32.

Recovered DLL sha256 18f719ed9b2fc36fd842068eb18bb4f5e385924442b348df17759658aa13a034, exports DllUpdate/Install/MainThread/ServiceMain/Uninstall. The loader patches a settings record into this image before launch; the recovered image is a static pre-patch reconstruction, not an original downloaded file.

R.exe configuration decode: ((byte+0x86)&255)^0x46 across 0x458 bytes at VA 0x4e3c20, followed by nine-byte word-spaced XOR of its first third, yields hackerinvasion.f3322.net and System Remote Data Simulation Layer service text. Endpoint was not accessed.

Recovered DLL 0x10004960 dispatches the leading received opcode. Opcode 12 maps through the byte-index/jump tables to 0x10004cae, skips the opcode and passes the remainder to WinExec. Socket framing and response/send routines are implemented, including 0x10001af0 -> 0x10001c90.

Decoded DLL 0x10005e80 gets the current executable path, copies it to Common Files/scvhost.exe and writes an HKCU Run value. 0x10006080 -> 0x1000c830 surveys named security processes; the survey is included in the host report at 0x10006110.
samples.coverage: No trait edits needed for the original: all two hostile loader/disguise findings and the security-process survey remain accurate. The decoded DLL independently fires the existing remote-command and disguised-autorun rules.
limits: Initial delivery/authorization and actor attribution are unknown. No ransomware or coinminer behavior follows from the collector filename. The second packed stage remains unclassified.
